status.title: Status
status.subtitle: Central OS Patch, Software Deployment & Self-Service Management for Windows & Linux
status.name: Name
status.not_configured_description: Configure a fully qualified domain name (FQDN) and administrator password in Settings to activate the Traefik HTTPS route and onboard clients.
status.onboarding_title: How to deploy the Management Agent & Software Center to your clients
status.onboarding_subtitle: Managed Windows and Linux endpoints connect exclusively outbound via HTTPS/WSS (port 443) to {url} — no inbound firewall ports required on client machines.
status.step1_desc: Open the Client Rollout Wizard inside the Web Console and generate a time- or usage-limited token (with either Auto-Approve or manual admin approval).
status.step2_desc: The bootstrap installer sets up the background system service (swm-agent) for OS patches & mandatory packages, plus the end-user 'NS8 Software Center' app (swm-center) in the Start Menu & system tray on workstations.
status.step3_title: Single PC, AD GPO, or Ansible
status.step3_desc: Run the one-line PowerShell/Bash command for quick testing, or download the idempotent Active Directory GPO startup script (.ps1) or Ansible playbook (.yml) for fleet-wide deployment.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure Traefik HTTPS endpoint, NS8 user domain, and administrator credentials
settings.domain_name_helper: Clients and administrators connect to this HTTPS hostname on port 443 via NS8 Traefik.
settings.ldap_domain_helper: Optional NS8 user domain allowing IT administrators to sign in to the Web Console with Active Directory or LDAP credentials.
settings.admin_username_helper: Local emergency and initial bootstrap administrator account for the Web Console.
settings.admin_password_placeholder: Leave blank to keep existing password
settings.admin_password_helper: Set a known password during initial setup; leave blank later unless you want to rotate it.
settings.initial_password_hint_desc: When saving for the first time, set a password for the local administrator (or select an NS8 user domain) so you can sign in to the Web Console right away.
settings.saved_description: Traefik routing and SoftwareManager settings have been updated.
settings.info_outbound_desc: Windows and Linux clients connect via HTTPS and WebSocket (WSS) through NS8 Traefik to the configured FQDN. No inbound ports are needed on endpoints.
settings.info_auth_desc: On the Web Console login screen you can switch between 'Local Admin' and 'NS8 Domain (LDAP/AD)'. All agent jobs are cryptographically signed with Ed25519.
settings.info_clients_desc: On workstations, the 'NS8 Software Center' app talks over a secured local IPC channel to the system service so standard users can install approved apps safely.
